none: PAS LIN-156706: Roman silver finger ring
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete Roman silver 'ToT' ring of Henig type VIII. The ring has a circular bezel and incomplete triangular shoulders. The shoulders are worn but each one is decorated with two pellets, one in each surviving corner. The bezel is inscribed with two serrifed 'T's with a pellet between. The inscription T.T is an abbreviation of the Celtic god-name Totatis. Rings bearing the inscription ToT are commonly found in the East Midlands, especially in Lincolnshire
